title: Elizabeth, NJ — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]

content:
Overview

Elizabeth is a city in NJ with a population of 130,000. Port city with Newark Liberty Airport, the Jersey Gardens Mall, and diverse communities. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree.
